name: status-island
title: Status Island
description: A floating pill appears when a background task starts, showing its spinner and percentage. Hovering, focusing or clicking it expands into a list of every task, where finished ones get a green tick and an action button.
use: Long uploads, exports or syncs should stay visible and inspectable without blocking the page.
avoid: The list is 320px wide and driven by a tasks prop, so it needs task state plus hover or focus to read more than one job.
a11y: Focus opens the list and Escape closes it, with a polite live region for changes. The pill removes its focus outline, so keyboard focus is hard to see. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded pill sits low on the stage, holding a small ring icon, a job label with a dim detail and a percentage or action chip. Expanded, it becomes a taller rounded panel with one row per task, each with its icon, label and percentage or small button; thin stacked layers peek behind the closed pill.
behaves: The pill fades and blurs in when a task starts and swaps its text as the newest task changes. Hover, focus or click opens the list with a spring; leaving or pressing Escape closes it. Rows swap the ring for a green tick when done, and finished tasks leave on their own.
customise: Tasks come in as an array with label, detail, status, progress and an optional action. Dismiss delay and className are props; the spring, colours and 320px list width are in the source.
weight: light: A few DOM rows and one layout spring; the progress ring animates only while a task runs.
